statements.t: In July 2026, the Company announced the FEP project, an intrastate natural gas transmission infrastructure project designed to support South Florida’s growing energy needs to be undertaken by Peninsula Pipeline on behalf of FEP which will own the FEP Project.

FEP and Peninsula Pipeline have entered into a Construction, Operations, and Management Agreement dated as of September 1, 2026, pursuant to which Peninsula Pipeline will provide certain services related to the development, construction, marketing and operation of the FEP Project.
